izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.datasimswitche.description:
A lightweight, purely root-based Quick Settings tile to switch the default mobile data SIM on dual-SIM Android devices.
 Unlike other implementations that rely on Shizuku and persistent background daemons, Data SIM Switcher uses topjohnwu's libsu to spawn a Root IPC service for the exact millisecond the tile is tapped. It is incredibly fast, survives reboots reliably, and uses zero background battery.

 Zero Daemons: Uses on-demand Magisk/KernelSU root access.

izzyondroid:com.strawing.fuckdevicepolic.name: FuckDevicePolicy
izzyondroid:com.strawing.fuckdevicepolic.summary: render user restriction policy (e.g work profile policies) nonfunctional
izzyondroid:com.strawing.fuckdevicepolic.description:
FuckDevicePolicy is an Xposed module that lets you render some user restriction policies (set by Device Admin App or Work Profile, e.g. Microsoft Intune) nonfunctional. Especially some device-wide policies, even it is in the Work Profile but affected the outside whole android environment (Your Personal Profile).
 For example, since Android 10, a new feature for Work Profile added: DISALLOW_INSTALL_UNKNOWN_SOURCES_GLOBALLY , value is "no_install_unknown_sources_globally"). This allows the Work Profile App (For example, Microsoft Intune, aka Company Portal) disable the permission of installing APKs from unknown source GLOBALLY , even its inside the Work Profile, then you also can not install APKs in your personal profile! Another example of device-wide restriction is ensure_verify_apps , which can make Google Play Protect always enable.
 If you are facing these problem, just use this Xposed module.
 Check UserManager to get all restriction policy values (See [Constant Value]). Put those you want to disable in this module's App, one line one policy value. Use dumpsys device_policy (run via adb shell or root) to check what restriction policies applied on your device (under [userRestrictions:] section).
 Only apply this module to [System Framework] (which is the default scope setting), no need to apply to any other apps, especially DO NOT apply to Microsoft Intune, otherwise your Xposed and ROOT will be detected.
 Due to LSPosed's New XSharedPreferences , if you are using LSPosed, please Activate this module and reboot firstly, before edit and save your custom policies!!! (In another word, when you click the save button, this module should be activated, if you are using LSPosed). Otherwise your custom policies will not be saved correctly for LSPosed.

* No third-party SDKs (no Firebase, no Google Play Services, no ads)
* All settings are stored locally on your device
* No data leaves your device

fdroid:io.github.picocrypt_ng.picocrypt_.name: Picocrypt-NG
fdroid:io.github.picocrypt_ng.picocrypt_.summary: Paranoid, offline file encryption with XChaCha20 and Argon2id.
fdroid:io.github.picocrypt_ng.picocrypt_.description:
Picocrypt-NG encrypts files locally — a community-maintained continuation of Picocrypt. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry, no network access (the app does not request the INTERNET permission).
XChaCha20 for encryption, with the key derived from your password by Argon2id. Every volume is authenticated, so tampering or corruption is detected on decryption.
Features:
- Encrypt a single file, multiple files, or a folder
- Optional keyfiles, with an option to require them in a fixed order
- Paranoid mode: extra cipher cascade and harder key derivation
- Reed-Solomon error correction to recover volumes from limited corruption
- Deniability mode: the encrypted volume appears as random data
- Optional compression
- Comments stored with the volume
- Optional verify-before-write integrity check
- Long operations continue in a foreground service when the app is backgrounded
Volumes are cross-platform with the desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux). A multi-file or compressed volume contains a single .zip inside; Android saves it without extracting.
Free software under GPLv3. The Android app is built from source: the native library is compiled from the Go sources in this repository, with no prebuilt binaries committed.

flathub:app.eduroam.geteduroam.summary: A geteduroam client for Linux. Geteduroam simplifies the process of connecting to eduroam
flathub:app.eduroam.geteduroam.description:
Geteduroam is a proposed extension of the NREN T&I services, aimed at increasing the update and use of eduroam by students and faculty members. The idea is to do away with the need for separate eduroam user accounts, and instead use national federated Id (through eduGAIN such as SURFconext, Swamid, FEIDE, HAKA, etc) to automatically generate eduroam login credentials in form of client certificates as needed. In addition, geteduroam will deliver apps for user devices that will automatically install and configure eduroam.
 Eduroam is seen as one of the most successful NREN services. eduroam service deployment is extensive, with nearly every campus in Europe having an eduroam Wi-Fi network. However, in terms of users who have eduroam installed correctly on their devices, the uptake is much less. This is believed to be the results of 1) users need a separate eduroam account, 2) users need to install and configure this account on their device, 3) the need to do so become apparent to users only when they are away from their home institution.
 At the time eduroam was developed, there was no simple way around this. Today, with the widespread adoption of federated Id and the global collaboration of such Id’s under eduGAIN, it is possible to develop what is essentially a more modern way on managing and deploying eduroam for users. This is the objective of the geteduroam project.

firefox-addons:986239.name: PrivateBookmark
firefox-addons:986239.summary: Looks for bookmarks containing keyword (defined in preferences) in the title field. For all found URLs a listener is defined that cancels request in normal window and instead opens a new private tab for the url.
firefox-addons:986239.description:
This add-on register listener on webRequests (only for URLs marked in bookmarks as private). Original request is blocked and instead URL is open in a new private window (or in already opened if one exists).
Private bookmarks are those containing keyword defined in preferences page (default is "private"). Keyword must be included in the title field of a bookmark. This is a bit inconvenient but current WebExtensions API does not support any other bookmark field. Once API is updated I will add support also for marking private bookmarks using TAGs.
You can trace progress of API development in here 
Happy private browsing!

firefox-addons:2817227.name: Webpage to Video
firefox-addons:2817227.summary: Converts web pages or local HTML files you are currently looking at into videos. The videos are produced in the mp4 (H264) format.
firefox-addons:2817227.description:
Don't just capture a static snapshot of a webpage—record how it moves and changes over time! 
Quickly convert any webpage or local HTML file into a high-quality MP4 video. This is the perfect solution for capturing dynamic content that standard screenshot tools simply cannot catch.
 Perfect for: 
 Capturing CSS animations and dynamic web designs for portfolios.
 Recording interactive charts, graphs, and live data dashboards.
 Documenting visual bugs or UI/UX issues for developers.
 Archiving webpages with moving elements or embedded media.
 How It Works: 
This extension securely reads the content of your current web page and sends it to GrabzIt's API for conversion. The final MP4 video is automatically downloaded in your browser.
 Getting Started & Pricing: 
Once installed, simply follow the instructions in the extension popup to create your free GrabzIt account and start converting.
 Free Tier: Core webpage-to-video conversions are free forever.
 Premium Features: You will automatically start with a free trial of our Premium tier. Afterward, you can optionally upgrade to automatically hide cookie notices, increase your monthly conversion allowance, and unlock advanced capture settings.
 Backed by GrabzIt Limited's enterprise-grade infrastructure. Fast, secure, and reliable.

firefox-addons:2890660.name: Shop Ethical!
firefox-addons:2890660.summary: Adds Shop Ethical! ratings to brand names on online shopping sites to help you choose more ethical options.
firefox-addons:2890660.description:
The Shop Ethical! browser extension gives you the low-down on the environmental and social record of companies behind common brands you buy in Australian supermarkets and beyond. Shop online with a clear conscience!
Key Features:
👩🏻💻See brand ratings right where you're doing your shopping, on sites like Woolies, Coles, Amazon, etc.
📊 We do the work for you - we've gathered information from over 90 sources to give you a clear picture of a company's ethical track record
✅Simple A-F rating system makes it easy to see at a glance which are the better picks
❗Please note, to get full access to the extension, you'll need to be a Shop Ethical! subscriber, which costs $5/month. You can cancel any time and you'll still be able to use the extension, you just won't get data updates.
⭐How it works:
The most comprehensive digital guide to ethical shopping in Australia, Shop Ethical! has been designed to provide consumers with the easiest way to make informed purchasing decisions.
The Shop Ethical! browser extension features the most up to date data from the Shop Ethical! website - automatically updated daily.
Instantly see ratings for over 7,500 brands, so you can make an informed and ethical decision whenever they shop.
Hover over the rating to see more information about which company owns the brand and country of ownership, and click through to see our full company profiles from ethical.org.au .
⭐Why you should use our ratings:
By shopping ethically consumers can send a strong message for change and help support the practices that make our world a better place to live in.
Company ratings are based on information gathered from over 90 sources, including the work of organisations such as Greenpeace, Ethical Fashion Guide, WWF, Fairtrade and Amnesty International.
Our ratings use assessments from 4 broad categories:
- Social
- Environment
- Animal
- Business ethics
... with over 20 subcategories like Factory Farming, Palm Oil, Product Safey, Worker Rights, and Corporate Conduct.
⭐More about us:
The Shop Ethical! ratings are also available as an app on iOS or Android, and website ( ethical.org.au ), but the browser extension puts our ratings right where you are doing your shopping. 
⭐Tips for using the extension:
You'll need to be a Shop Ethical! subscriber to get access to the full data - find out more at ethical.org.au/browser-extension . The cost is just $5 per month which helps to fund our small team in the work we're doing. You can unsubscribe any time, and you'll still be able to use the extension, but you won't get any more data updates.
Sometimes, brand names are also common words (think Apple!). So, you may sometimes see some "false positives" as you're browsing. Use your common sense to work out whether it's really a brand name in context.

apple-itunes:737311241.description:
Save space on a device, have instant access to your audio files,video files anywhere (Dropbox®, Google Drive®, Box, OneDrive®).
Listen to your music, audiobooks and play videos directly from the cloud !
If you've got large iTunes music library this music player is the perfect solution to access your favorite songs and entire music library - without taking up any extra device space and synchronization hassle.
Once you moved your music collection to the cloud, MediaCloud connects to any of your cloud including DropBox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive and streams your music or video directly from there.
Features
・ plays mp3, aac, m4a, wav, aiff, m4r, mp4, caf, mov, avi
・ create playlists from music in multiple cloud services
・ favorite folders for fast access
・ gesture control in the player
・ narration speed control and bookmark for audiobooks listening
・ single universal app for iPhone and iPad

flathub:fr.morfredus.AntRenamerQt.description:
Ant Renamer Qt renames many files and folders in one go: replace, insert, move or delete text,
 enumerate, change case, regular expressions, names taken from a list, and tags read from MP3 files

 with its language files and help.
